about: The epistola of the formulary “Easter Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Brethren: Purge out the old leaven, that you may be a new paste, as you are unleavened. For Christ our Pasch is sacrificed. Therefore let us feast, not with the old leaven, nor with the leaven of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.
